items.title: SaaSmageddon Survivors: 5 Top Software Stocks to Buy
items.summary: These five software stocks turned the "AI kills SaaS" panic into their biggest tailwinds — and Wall Street thinks there's more growth ahead.

items.title: Can Rising Network Security Demand Boost PANW's Long-Term Growth?
items.summary: Palo Alto Networks' strong firewall bookings, software growth and AI-driven traffic demand are strengthening its Network Security growth outlook.

items.title: Cybersecurity Stocks Are Priced For Big AI Growth. Earnings Could Bring Fireworks.
items.summary: Heading into the earnings reports for CrowdStrike, Okta, SentinelOne, Palo Alto Networks and Zscaler, cybersecurity stocks have been on fire. With expectations running high, the cybersecurity stocks could be volatile if financial results underwhelm investors.

items.title: Cisco Grows Into Its Multiple, And The Market Has To Do The Rest
items.summary: Consensus has the earnings arriving, and the multiple falling, yet the scenario that follows leaves a holder within a few percent of today's price unless the market goes on paying a richer forward multiple than it does today.

items.title: This Analyst Just Upped Its Price Target on Palo Alto Networks Stock. Here's Why.
items.summary: Benchmark raised the price target on Palo Alto Networks stock to $400. Here’s why the firm is bullish on PANW shares.

items.title: 5 of the Most-Upgraded Stocks Over the Last Quarter Are All Software Names—Here's Why
items.summary: Snowflake, Okta, Datadog, CrowdStrike and Palo Alto Networks lead MarketBeat's most-upgraded stocks list, as analysts raise price targets on software firms benefiting from AI adoption.

items.title: Palo Alto Networks Could Be Worth Over $433 - 21% More  - as Analysts Hike Their Revenue Forecasts
items.summary: Palo Alto Networks is set to release its fiscal Q4 earnings on Sept. 1. Since my last article, when I set a $402 price target, analysts have raised their revenue forecasts. The new PANW PT is $433, 21% higher.

items.title: CrowdStrike May Have A Big Surprise In Store For Investors On August 26th
items.summary: CrowdStrike heads into its August 26 earnings report carrying momentum that has surprised Wall Street eight times in a row, and the setup heading into fiscal Q2 2027 suggests investors may want to pay close attention before the opening bell that morning.
